```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(readxl)

source('../../ccMeetTools.R')
boysVarsity <- read_excel('greatAmerican2026.xlsx', sheet='boysBlue') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
boysJV <- read_excel('greatAmerican2026.xlsx', sheet='boysJV') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
girlsVarsity <- read_excel('greatAmerican2026.xlsx', sheet='girlsBlue') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
```

## Competition summary
Great American is a huge meet. Conley had athletes in the Blue Division and in the Boys JV race.

### D.H. Conley Athlete times

```{r}
buildTeamTable(boysVarsity, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=7)
buildTeamTable(boysJV, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=5)
buildTeamTable(girlsVarsity, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=5)
```


### Boys
```{r}
scoreMeetSimp(boysVarsity, "2026 Great American Blue")
```


